lines.en: One twist of my body is a meter

lines.zh: 风暴丛林的湿气让我的皮发亮
lines.en: The storm jungle's damp makes my skin shine

lines.zh: 我在草叶间穿，几乎没声音
lines.en: I weave between grass blades, almost silent
My tail flicks and the grass bends

lines.zh: 我多半在水里，可也能上岸
lines.en: I am mostly in water, but I can come ashore
A flicker of light in the puddle

lines.zh: 我走的是弯的，从不走直
lines.en: I move in curves, never straight
When rain comes, I come alive
I look like a length of wet rope
The wet soil in the grass is just right

lines.zh: 我抬起头，看看有没有人
lines.en: I lift my head to see if anyone is there
I lie by the water, motionless
Light travels along my skin
The storm jungle is always close and heavy
I coil my body
There is something moving in the water

lines.zh: 我等着，等人把手伸下水
lines.en: I wait for someone to reach into the water

lines.zh: 我身上的电，不响的时候也在
lines.en: The charge on me is there even when silent
Mud and water mix on my skin
This puddle is deep enough
You are by the water, standing too close

lines.zh: 我抬起头，从水里看着你
lines.en: I raise my head and look up at you from the water
Your feet are in the water
This skin of mine is slicker than rope
Would you like to touch it
I am not large, but I am quick
Step back and the water settles
I do well for myself in this stretch

lines.zh: 风暴丛林的水，都不干净
lines.en: The water in the storm jungle is never clean
There is a tang of iron on you

lines.zh: 我缩成一团，电闪了一下
lines.en: I curl up, and the charge sparks
A split in my skin

lines.zh: 我滑进水里，伤口在水里
lines.en: I slid into the water, the wound with me
I retreated far before stopping
I did not cry out, the water spoke for me
The charge on me scattered

lines.zh: 电在我皮下游走，找不到出口。
lines.en: The current roams under my skin, finding no way out.
I press low, and cannot move fast
Thin as I am, I cannot take blows
One was already enough
You hold it out over the water
I smell it, but I am in no hurry

lines.zh: 你指间那点光，比吃的更馋人。
lines.en: That glimmer between your fingers tempts me more than food.

lines.zh: 水里我自己能找到吃的
lines.en: I can find my own food in the water

lines.zh: 你手上的东西，比它更有意思
lines.en: What is on your hand interests me more

lines.zh: 我靠近了一点，水起了纹
lines.en: I came closer, and the water rippled

lines.zh: 这味道在水里散得很快
lines.en: This smell spreads fast in water
Let it go, drop it in the water

lines.zh: 我不要这个，我要会动的东西
lines.en: Not this, I want something that moves
Reach a little further

lines.zh: 你的靴子碰到我，水里噼啪一响。
lines.en: Your boot touches me; the water crackles.
I recoiled and water splashed up
That should have numbed your foot
Do not crowd me at the water's edge
I slid to your feet and away again
You slipped as you stepped back

lines.zh: 我一摆尾，河底的泥全翻起来。
lines.en: One flick of my tail churns up the riverbed.

lines.zh: 这一下不算什么，我还有别的
lines.en: That was nothing, I have more
Do not put your foot in to test me
Touch again and I bite
There are plenty of my kind in the storm jungle
The water has to be the right temperature
Our charges must be at the same frequency

lines.zh: 雨水多的时候，容易碰上
lines.en: In heavy rain we meet easily
The water is too murky now
I like this puddle
It swam off on its own
No hurry, the rainy season is long
Then let us wait a bit more
It is slick, dropped twice
Is this thing charged
I touched it and it jumped
I drag it into the water
Once in the water it is lost
What is this smell? Not fish
I circled and came back
It sank slowly away
Do not reach in, let me
I raised my head a little

lines.zh: 这一片水洼只有一个入口
lines.en: This puddle has only one entrance
Your steps in the water are loud
The charge on me begins to hum
There are no people in the storm jungle
I have coiled my body

lines.zh: 你手里那根东西，看起来有用
lines.en: That thing in your hand looks useful

lines.zh: 我等着，等你再走近一步
lines.en: I wait for you to take one more step
The mud by the water is slick
Your shadow fell into the water
Ripples are coming this way

lines.zh: 我把身子沉下去，只留眼睛
lines.en: I sink down, only my eyes showing
The noise on the bank stopped at the edge

lines.zh: 我的电让草尖都立起来
lines.en: The charge makes the grass tips stand up
I follow you in the water

lines.zh: 你在岸上走，我在水里追
lines.en: You walk the bank, I follow in the water
I know this area better than you

lines.zh: 我从水里抬头看了一眼
lines.en: I raised my head from the water to look
The mud will drag at your boots
I have swum ahead of you

lines.zh: 我身上的电让水面发亮
lines.en: The charge on me makes the water glow

lines.zh: 你回头的时候，水面是静的
lines.en: When you look back, the water is still

lines.zh: 我一直在你不看的那一侧
lines.en: I stay on the side you do not watch
There is no bridge here
Beyond that is deep water

lines.zh: 我在水里绕圈子，一直换位置
lines.en: I circle in the water, always shifting

lines.zh: 你往哪边走，水就往哪边响
lines.en: Whichever way you go, the water sounds that way

lines.zh: 我贴近泥底游，你看不见
lines.en: I swim close to the bottom, out of sight
Your feet sink deep in the mud
I have a whole stretch of water to move in
It is raining again, perfect

lines.zh: 我在你背后那一侧冒了头
lines.en: I surfaced on the side behind you
This road has only one bridge
I bite your ankle
I coil around your calf
That numbed your leg
The charge on me releases
You are thrown back into the water

lines.zh: 这一下不重，是让你记住
lines.en: That was not heavy, only to be remembered
Retreat, and I follow in the water
There is a mark on your leg
Once more and you go down
I slip into the water and surface again
The mud is under your feet, you cannot run
My teeth are short, and they find their place
In the water your strength shrinks

lines.zh: 这一下，你手里的东西掉了
lines.en: That shook the thing from your grip
Not a sound from start to finish

lines.zh: 我从水里冲出来，撞你小腿
lines.en: I burst from the water into your calf
I coil around your wrist
The current travels through the water
You are standing in the water, that is enough
A ring of ripples spread on the water
I raise my head out of the water
The storm jungle's rain just stopped
There is a new wet trail in the grass
The charge on me flashed once

lines.zh: 水洼里静了一下，然后动了
lines.en: The puddle went still, then moved
I slide out of the mud
This stretch, the water is just right
I coil on the bank waiting for rain
A flicker of light crossed the grass

lines.zh: 泥里翻出一段湿滑的东西
lines.en: Something wet and slick turns up from the mud
The water's bottom glimmered once

lines.zh: 火一烧，我皮上的水就没了
lines.en: Fire burnt the water off my skin

lines.zh: 我从岸上掉下去，摔在泥里
lines.en: I fell off the bank into the mud

lines.zh: 回到水里就好些，可浑水呛人
lines.en: Being back in water helps, but murky water chokes

lines.zh: 炸得我飞起来，又落回水里
lines.en: The blast threw me up and back into the water
An arrow is stuck in me

lines.zh: 那股劲儿和我身上的电撞了
lines.en: That force clashed with my charge
There is nothing left in the water to eat

lines.zh: 雷落下来，我身上的电跟着响
lines.en: Lightning struck and my charge answered

lines.zh: 这里没有水，我浑身不对劲
lines.en: No water here, and everything in me is wrong
